factual_accuracy_review.scope: Independent verification of every technical claim in this file against tools/aris_homepage.py source, skills/homepage-generator/SKILL.md, skills/homepage-generator/PROFILE_SCHEMA.md, and README.md's ARIS-Homepage section (audited jointly with docs/aris-homepage-windows-quickstart_CN.md in the same thread since both describe the same tool). Reviewer was instructed not to trust the document and to check ground truth itself (function names + line numbers required as evidence).

findings.claim: "DBLP/arXiv fact-checking only verifies that a title/venue/year/author combination is correct"
findings.correction: run_fact_check() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L1373-1493) never checks author lists — only bibkey existence, DBLP title match, year mismatch, venue mismatch, and award-badge URL sanity.

findings.claim: "[Paper]/[Code]/[Slides] links only render if you put them yourself in publications.bib (url/eprint fields) or profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links"
findings.correction: build_publications_section() (tools/aris_homepage.py ~L904-986, esp. L928-958 and L978-982) reads links EXCLUSIVELY from profile.yml's publications_meta.<bibkey>.links — a url/eprint field in publications.bib is valid BibTeX but is never consumed for rendering link buttons.

rounds.confirmed_claims_summary: Script filename/underscore (no installed aris-homepage command), the four-command pipeline (init -> agent fills extraction.json -> finalize -> render --persona theory-minimal) matching cmd_init/print_extraction_handoff/cmd_finalize, finalize's clear die() when extraction.json is missing, theory-minimal valid / active-researcher hard-disabled (PERSONAS + cmd_render), identity.photo local-base64/remote-URL embed with no fetching (build_photo_html), and the Windows-environment claims (.py file-association silence being external/not script-suppressed, python3 App Execution Alias stub, non-ASCII pdftotext path mangling as an external poppler-build limitation consistent with pdftotext being invoked as a subprocess arg, and CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED being consistent with the DBLP fetch path using urllib.request.urlopen, confirmed in dblp_search_title) — all CONFIRMED against source. One additional nuance surfaced (not an error in this file): cmd_finalize supports --out to target another workspace, cmd_render does not (always operates on cwd) — this file's examples already `cd` into the site dir before every command, so no fix was required for this point specifically.

rounds.notes: Targeted fixes for the two WRONG findings above were correct, but the closing sentence of the 'Your first CV-only site...' section still told users to add missing links/images in both profile.yml AND publications.bib — over-broad given the link-source finding.

Follow-up sentence tightened to point at profile.yml's publications_meta (links/thumbnail per bibkey) only. Reviewer re-read both audited files fresh from disk and confirmed no remaining issue from the audited claim set.
